title: F45 · no_friends · Nobody Picked Her
lines: They picked teams. And then there was one left.
You can be extra, they said.
At lunch she ate by the wall, and told her tiffin a story.
She told Mummy school was fine.
Outside the gate, the ice-cream man was giving the broken cones to a row of crows, a three-legged dog, and one very strange cat.
The ones nobody picks are my favourite team.
Next day at lunch there was a new girl by the wall. Also not picked.
I have a team, she said. Do you want to be in it?
"I have a team," she said. "Do you want to be in it?"
If nobody picks you, start the team. That is sadhana.
